Lean, toned and strong — not bulky. That's exactly what this plan (and the new daily target add-ons below) is built for:

  • Build the muscle: the dumbbell & strength sessions — plus each day's new target add-on — shape toned arms, legs, stomach and upper body.
  • Feed the muscle: protein at every meal helps you build and keep lean muscle while you lose fat.
  • Stay slim: the moderate 300–500 calorie deficit plus daily cardio burns the fat while the strength work keeps you firm.

Make It Stick

Morning Tips For Weight Loss

Hydration and Metabolism

  • Drink water early: Have 500 ml of water as soon as you wake up — it rehydrates your system and gives your metabolism a gentle kick-start for the day.
  • Try warm detox drinks: Sip warm water with lemon, or soaked cumin (jeera) water, to support smooth digestion and help reduce bloating.
  • Skip sugary coffee: Steer clear of loaded lattes, sweetened teas and packaged juices, as they spike your insulin early in the morning.

Balanced Nutrition

  • Eat high protein: Aim for 20–30 grams of protein from foods like eggs, sprouts, Greek yogurt or paneer, which helps keep hunger hormones like ghrelin under control.
  • Add fiber: Include nuts, chia seeds and fresh fruits in your meals to feel full for longer, without sharp blood sugar crashes.
  • Plan your day: Spend a few minutes mapping out your meals in advance, so you are less likely to eat impulsively later.

Movement and Light

  • Get morning light: Step outside for 10 minutes of natural light to sync your circadian rhythm and support healthy hormone balance.
  • Move your body: Go for a 20-minute brisk walk, some light stretching, or a short yoga session to switch your muscles on for the day.

Evening

4 PM to 6 PM
Warm-Up — Every Day, Before Your Exercises • 10 Minutes

What to do

1) 5 minutes light cardio
Treadmill walk, elliptical, or stationary bike — easy pace, you should be able to talk.

2) 5 minutes dynamic stretches

  • Arm circles — 30 seconds forward, 30 seconds back
  • Leg swings — front-to-back & side-to-side, 30 sec per leg
  • Torso twists — gentle, 45 seconds
  • Bodyweight hip openers — slow circles / gate openers, 1 minute
YouTube: 10-min warm-upG Google: dynamic stretches

Make It Stick

Evening Tips for Weight Loss

Timing

Wrap up your intense lifting or HIIT at least 1.5 to 2 hours before your regular bedtime, so a raised heart rate and cortisol levels don't disturb your sleep.

Fueling

Have a light pre-workout snack — like a banana or a small handful of almonds — about 45 minutes before your session, and follow it with a balanced dinner rich in protein and fiber.

Consistency

Pair this routine with a moderate calorie deficit of 300–500 calories below maintenance, for steady and sustainable fat loss.

  • Reboot with Protein: Have 20–25g of protein — such as a whey isolate shake, Greek yogurt, or paneer/tofu — to help repair muscle tissue without adding heavy calories.
  • Pair with Carbs: Include a small portion of complex carbs, like a small banana or a handful of roasted chana, to replenish the glycogen stores used during your session.
  • Hydrate Well: Drink 500ml of water or an electrolyte solution to replace the sweat lost during the 2-hour workout window.

Dinner Strategy

  • Keep It Light: Eat a balanced dinner built around lean protein (chicken, fish, eggs or lentils), a large portion of fiber-rich green vegetables, and controlled whole grains — like a small bowl of dal-khichdi or a single roti.
  • Limit Heavy Fats and Sugars: Avoid heavy oils, deep-fried items and refined carbs, which slow down digestion right before bed.
  • Mind the Clock: Finish eating at least 2–3 hours before you sleep, to allow proper digestion and prevent overnight fat storage.

Recovery & Sleep Habits

  • Wind Down Early: Avoid high-intensity physical activity and large doses of caffeine in the evening, so your heart rate and core temperature can drop.
  • Prioritize Rest: Aim for 7–8 hours of sleep — late-afternoon workouts boost metabolism, and good sleep prevents hunger hormones (ghrelin) from rising the next day.

My Everyday Manifestation Routine

  • Morning — Water Manifestation: with my first water of the day, I hold the glass, speak my intentions into the water, visualise, and drink slowly.
  • 369 Method: I write my favourite affirmation 3 times in the morning, 6 times in the afternoon, 9 times at night, for 21 days.
  • Scripting: I write in my Journal page as if my dream life is already happening.
  • Visualisation: I close my eyes for 2–3 minutes and feel my dream life as real, now.
  • Gratitude: I end every day thankful — gratitude multiplies my blessings.

Water Manifestation — My Daily Ritual

  1. I take a clean glass of water and hold it with both hands.
  2. I close my eyes, take three deep breaths, and think of what I am manifesting.
  3. I speak my intentions into the water, slowly and clearly, in the present tense — as if they are already true.
  4. I visualise my dream life as real while the water absorbs my words and energy.
  5. I drink the water slowly, feeling my intentions spread through every cell of my body.
  6. I say “Thank you, it is done.”

My water affirmation: “I am Swetha. Money, wealth, fame, success, career growth, perfect health, my loving partner and pure love flow into my life easily as I drink this water. Everything I desire is already mine. Thank you, Universe.”
